modules.title: Settings
modules.intro: Choose the modules your guild uses and configure each module's options.
modules.mapperDescription: Collaborative maps, connections and timers for the Avalon Roads.
modules.preservationHint: Disabling interrupts access to the Mapper, including active sessions. Your maps remain saved and return when the module is enabled again.
modules.botHint: Sends a warning before a route closes and another when its timer ends. Only Guild maps visible to everyone trigger notifications; personal and restricted maps are excluded. Leave the channel empty to disable notifications.
modules.channelHint: Enter the channel in this server where the bot should announce routes about to close or already closed.
modules.saveError: Could not save settings. Please try again.
modules.invalidChannel: Enter a valid channel ID containing up to 20 digits.
modules.noneHint: This guild's modules are disabled. The Guild Master can enable them in settings.

modules.confirmDisableHint: Access to the module will stop, including active sessions. Saved maps will be preserved.
